A340E (2JZ-GTE) AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION - FORWARD CLUTCH

D4837

3. REMOVE FLANGE, PLATES AND DISCS
(a) Using a screwdriver, remove the snap ring from the forward clutch drum.
(b) Remove the flange, 7 plates and 7 discs.

SST

SST

AT5166

4. REMOVE PISTON RETURN SPRING
(a) Place SST on the spring retainer and compress the return spring with a shop press.
SST 09350-30020  (09350-07040)
(b) Using SST, remove the snap ring.
SST 09350-30020  (09350-07070)

AT5167

(c) Remove the piston return spring.

AT5368

5. REMOVE FORWARD CLUTCH PISTON
(a) Place the forward clutch drum onto the O/D support.
(b) Hold the forward clutch piston with hand, apply compressed air to the O/D support to remove the forward clutch piston.
(c) Remove the forward clutch piston.

O-Ring

AT7824

6. REMOVE 2 O-RINGS FROM PISTON
